title: Primordial gravitational waves, precisely: The role of thermodynamics in the Standard Model
authentication: PDF page zero explicitly identifies v2 and 17 May 2018. Appendix A names anc/standardmodel2018.dat as the authors' public effective-degrees-of-freedom dataset.
extraction: The numerical table header identifies authors, year and columns T[GeV], g_rho, its error, g_s, its error. The full table is retained as scientific numerical input; no full PDF is retained.
project_application: Use central g_rho(T),g_s(T), entropy conservation and Friedmann expansion to convert exponential parent decay times to scale factors and collisionless daughter momenta. EOS error columns are retained but not propagated as a separate uncertainty distribution.
verdict: verified source identification and numerical-table translation; cosmological production conclusions remain conditional on the explicitly declared fixed-pole early-NR and collisionless assumptions
